mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi WHERE source_order_id=#{orderId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_order_link WHERE order_id=#{orderId})

SELECT p.trade_type, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.document_snapshot, '$.business.salesChannel')), 'null') sales_channel, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.document_snapshot, '$.business.domesticShipment')) domestic_shipment FROM bike_pi p WHERE p.source_order_id=#{orderId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_order_link l WHERE l.order_id=#{orderId} AND l.series_id=p.series_id) ORDER BY p.id
